title: International Ministerial Conference on Veterans' Issues agrees to joint Statement of Intent
content:
2 November 2018

International Ministerial Conference on Veterans' Issues agrees to joint Statement of Intent

  • Hon Ron Mark
Veterans

Coinciding with the opening of the Invictus Games, Minister for Veterans Ron Mark met with his counterparts, or their representatives, from Australia, Canada, the United Kingdom and the United States at an International Ministerial Conference on Veterans’ Issues at the Australian National Maritime Museum in Sydney on 20 and 21 October 2018.

During the meeting a Statement of Intent was agreed upon.  The Statement recognises the benefits of our nations working together for our veterans. 

The full Statement of Intent is now available and is attached to this release.

A joint media statement was also released, and can be found here: http://minister.dva.gov.au/media_releases/2018/oct/va102.htm
